title: Lexus LX 600
verdict: The only 300 Series Land Cruiser America could buy, sold with 22-inch wheels and an apology for the missing V8. Brilliant chassis, so check the engine's paperwork.

paragraphs: When Toyota decided the [[land-cruiser/300-series|300 Series]] Land Cruiser wouldn't be sold in North America, the LX 600 became the only way to buy one here. Unveiled on October 13, 2021, it moved to the new GA-F ladder frame, lost 441 lb compared with the [[lexus/lx570|LX 570]] and swapped the old 5.7-liter V8 for a 409-hp, 479 lb-ft 3.4-liter twin-turbo V6 and a 10-speed automatic. The trim is fancier than any Land Cruiser buyer asked for, but the low range, locking center diff and solid rear axle are pure Land Cruiser.

story.heading: THE LAND CRUISER AMERICA COULDN'T BUY
paragraphs: The LX has always been a Land Cruiser in a better suit, from the 80 Series-based [[lexus/lx450|LX 450]] through the [[land-cruiser/200-series|200 Series]]-based LX 570. Lexus says the LX has been sold in more than 50 countries and regions, with over 500,000 sold by August 2021. Its 112-in wheelbase dates back to the first LX of 1995. When the 300 Series arrived without a US version, one launch report summed up the mood: 'Many were disappointed to learn that the 300-Series Toyota Land Cruiser wouldn't come to the U.S.'

The LX 600 filled that hole with five grades at launch: Standard, Premium, Luxury, F Sport and Ultra Luxury. The Ultra Luxury is a four-seat limousine with 48-degree reclining rear seats. The F Sport adds 22-inch forged wheels, a rear stabilizer and a Torsen limited-slip rear differential. None of the US grades got front or rear lockers. Those stayed in Japan, which got an LX 'Offroad' grade with all three differentials locking.

story.heading: WHAT THE NEW CHASSIS BROUGHT
paragraphs: Lexus describes the GA-F frame as 20 percent more rigid. The front uses high-mounted double wishbones, and the rear keeps a four-link axle with lateral control arms. Suspension travel is 100 mm of bound and 145 mm of rebound, and rear rebound alone grew by 20 mm. Active Height Control offers Low, Normal, Hi1 and Hi2 heights, and adaptive dampers use linear solenoid valves. At normal height, the approach, breakover and departure angles are 25°, 23° and 20°.

The off-road electronics got smarter too. Multi-Terrain Select has six modes, including a first-for-Lexus Auto setting that reads the terrain from sensor data. Crawl Control offers five speeds, and the Multi-Terrain Monitor adds four cameras and an underfloor view. Lexus rates it to climb 45 degrees and wade 700 mm (27.5 in). Not everyone wants the gadgets, though. Slee Off-Road's 'Marshmello' build was a Premium LX 600 custom-ordered without AHC so it could run Dobinsons suspension.

story.heading: THE ENGINE QUESTION
paragraphs: The V35A-FTS is where the LX 600 story gets complicated. In 2024, Toyota recalled 102,092 Tundras and LX 600s, 3,524 of them LXs built from July 30, 2021 to November 25, 2022, because machining debris could damage the main bearings. The remedy was a new engine. In November 2025, recall 25V-767 added another 9,895 US-market LXs built from February 26, 2022 to April 2, 2024. That count includes 10 trucks that had received affected service engines. At first Lexus told dealers the remedy was still being developed. NHTSA's record now says dealers inspect the No. 1 main bearing using inspection software and drive data and replace the engine if necessary, with owner letters mailed August 28, 2026.

The recall report notes that some later engines use improved manufacturing processes or an improved main bearing. On IH8MUD, owners argue about it constantly. Some see the recall as an open-ended engine warranty, while others are waiting for Toyota to name a root cause. Owners also report a clunk into first gear on rolling stops and laggy throttle tied to the pre-collision system. Neither is dangerous, but both are worth knowing about before you test-drive one.

story.heading: WHERE IT STANDS
paragraphs: The LX 600 has sold steadily for something this expensive, with 3,642 US sales in 2022, 6,959 in 2023, 6,830 in 2024 and 7,464 in 2025, when 2,883 of those were the new LX 700h hybrid. That hybrid makes 457 hp and 583 lb-ft. In October 2024, Lexus finally gave Americans the triple-locked LX it had kept in Japan: the LX 700h Overtrail, with front and rear lockers on top of the center lock.

For 2027, the gas LX 600 continues in Premium, Luxury and F Sport Handling grades. The EPA rates the 2025 LX 600 at 17 city, 22 highway and 19 combined. It's still the most luxurious way into a 300 Series chassis, and with the shorter, boxier [[lexus/gx550|GX 550]] now on the same platform, it's no longer the only GA-F Lexus that can go off-road.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · THE LX AMERICA DIDN'T GET (AT FIRST)
callout.title: Japan's triple-locked LX, and its US answer
paragraphs: When the LX 600 launched, Japan got a model called the LX Offroad, with front, center and rear differential locks. US buyers got a choice between leather and more leather. The closest US equivalent was the F Sport, whose Torsen rear limited-slip and 22-inch forged wheels suit a canyon road more than a trail.

That changed on October 10, 2024, when Lexus revealed the LX 700h Overtrail with front and rear lockers plus the standard center lock. Owners on IH8MUD have worked out the rules. The center lock can engage on the move, 4L needs the truck stopped in neutral, and the axle lockers need 4L and the center lock engaged first, at very low speed.

engineering_intro: The LX 600 is a 300 Series Land Cruiser underneath. It sits on the GA-F ladder frame, which Lexus says is 20 percent more rigid, with high-mounted double wishbones up front and a four-link solid rear axle with lateral control arms. Power from the 3.4-liter twin-turbo V6 goes through a 10-speed automatic and a two-speed transfer case to a lockable center differential. Hydraulic Active Height Control and AVS adaptive damping manage ride height and comfort, and Multi-Terrain Select, Crawl Control and an underfloor camera handle the trail.

engineering.note: 441 lb lighter than the LX 570 and 20% more rigid. The wheelbase stays at 112 in.

Lateral control arms. Rear rebound up 20 mm over the LX 570.

buying_checks.head: Recall status, in writing
buying_checks.body: Run the VIN for 24V-381 (engine replacement, trucks built July 2021 to November 2022) and 25V-767 (Lexus 25LA07, built February 2022 to April 2024). Get dealer paperwork showing what was done. A replaced engine is a selling point.

buying_checks.head: Listen for a knock
buying_checks.body: The recalls list knocking, rough running, a no-start and a loss of power as symptoms. Start it cold and listen at idle and under light load.

buying_checks.head: Rolling-stop behavior
buying_checks.body: Owners report a clunk into first gear during rolling stops on 2022–2024 trucks, plus sluggish throttle that eases when the pre-collision system is set to its shortest distance. Test both so you know what's normal for these trucks.

buying_checks.head: Which grade?
buying_checks.body: The F Sport gets a Torsen rear LSD and a rear stabilizer bar, but also 22-in forged wheels that limit tire choice. Ultra Luxury is a four-seater. US LX 600s have no axle lockers in any grade.

buying_checks.head: AHC health
buying_checks.body: Cycle through Low, Normal, Hi1 and Hi2 and confirm each height is reached and held. Some trucks were ordered without AHC. Know which one you're buying, because lift options differ.

buying_checks.head: Tailgate and electronics
buying_checks.body: An owner-reported power hatch that beeps and refuses to close was usually a weak key-fob signal or a hatch that needed a manual close to relearn its position. Check that everything works before you assume a fault.

buying_checks.head: Bulletin and warranty history
buying_checks.body: Ask for the dealer service history. Lexus has issued bulletins for front-brake squeal on 2022–2024 trucks (L-SB-0036-24), a windshield-molding buzz above 55 mph (L-SB-0019-24) and a head-unit software update for 2022 models (L-SB-0027-24). Work already done under them is a good sign.

buying_checks.head: Power back door
buying_checks.body: Open and close the hatch several times with the button, the key and the kick sensor. If it beeps twice and won't move, suspect a pinch sensor. IH8MUD owners have had them replaced under warranty.

repairs.title: Engine recall check (24V-381 / 25V-767)
repairs.time: ≈ 10 minutes to check. Dealer time varies.
repairs.symptoms: Possible engine knocking, rough running, a no-start or a loss of motive power. Many trucks show nothing.
repairs.fix: Enter the VIN at lexus.com/recall or nhtsa.gov/recalls. Under 24V-381, Toyota replaces the engine at no cost. Under 25V-767, NHTSA's record now says dealers inspect the No. 1 main bearing using inspection software and drive data and replace the engine if necessary; owner letters were mailed August 28, 2026. Keep every piece of paperwork.

repairs.title: Early differential, transfer case and transmission fluid service
repairs.symptoms: None. This is preventive work. Some owners choose to change gear oil early after reports of debris in V35A Tundra differentials after break-in.
repairs.fix: One IH8MUD owner did a 20k-mile service on an LX 700h. That covered the differential gear oil, a transmission fluid exchange and the transfer case, plus greasing the driveline zerks. Their wear-metal results were reassuring. Another owner reports Red Line 75W-85 working fine in the front diff. Remove the skid plates for access, and follow the factory manual's fluid specs and fill levels.
repairs.tools: Socket set · fluid pump · drain pan · torque wrench · gear oil per factory spec · grease gun

repairs.title: Front skid plate install
repairs.symptoms: The factory underbody protection on most LX 600s isn't trail-ready. The LX 700h Overtrail is the exception, with a steel skid from the factory.
repairs.fix: Bolt the aftermarket skid to the frame mounts, and change the front diff fluid while you're under there. One owner fitting Slee's skid to an F Sport found that a bracket didn't line up with the tow-hook points, likely because of the F Sport's different bumper and chassis vibration damper. Confirm fitment for your grade before you start.
repairs.tools: Floor jack · sockets · torque wrench · skid plate kit (e.g. Slee Off-Road)

parts.name: SLEE skid plate system with cat protection, high-strength steel, LX 600
SLEE skid plate system with cat protection, aluminum, LX 600
Gear oil for the front diff change, 2023 LX 600

repairs.title: Laggy throttle at rolling stops
repairs.symptoms: Delayed or missing throttle response pulling out of a rolling stop on 2024 trucks. Owners say it's worse in Sport and Sport+.
repairs.fix: Owners traced it to the pre-collision system limiting torque. As an interim fix, set PCS to its shortest warning distance, one green bar, in the gauge-cluster menu. Turning PCS off removes the lag but also disables a key safety system. Ask your dealer about software updates.

repairs.title: Bigger tires on aftermarket wheels
repairs.symptoms: Not a fault. The factory 22s limit you to low-profile tires that dislike rocks.
repairs.fix: Owners report running 275/55R20 and 285/55R20 on 30-offset Vossen 20s without rubbing, 275/60R20 (about 33 in) on aftermarket 20s, and 275/70R18 on Toyota TRD 18s. One dealer forced 285/50R22 A/Ts onto factory wheels, but it took cutting and spacers.
repairs.tools: Lug wrench · torque wrench · hub-centric wheels in the right offset · TPMS sensors

parts.name: Spidertrax 1 in hub-centric wheel spacers, 6x5.5, fits '22+ LX (pair)

repairs.title: Front brake squeal (bulletin L-SB-0036-24)
repairs.time: ≈ 2 hours for front pads and rotors (estimate)
repairs.cost: Covered under the bulletin while in warranty (owner report). Otherwise pads and rotors.
repairs.symptoms: A squeal from the front brakes when moving forward or in reverse. Owners mostly hear it on the first stops of a cold or humid morning, and it fades once the brakes warm up.
repairs.fix: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0036-24 (October 2024) covers front-brake squeal on 2022–2024 LX 600s and 2024 GX 550s. An IH8MUD owner's dealer said the fix was new front pads and rotors at no charge, though the parts were back-ordered at the time. Ask a dealer to check your VIN against the bulletin first. Out of warranty, fit new pads and rotors, clean the caliper hardware and pad abutments, use a thin film of brake grease where the pads slide, and bed the new pads in.
repairs.tools: Lug wrench · socket set · torque wrench · brake cleaner · high-temperature brake grease · pads and rotors

repairs.title: Windshield rattle or buzz at speed (bulletin L-SB-0019-24)
repairs.time: Dealer visit. A few minutes to clear leaves from the cowl.
repairs.cost: Warranty work under the bulletin. Free for the cowl clean-out.
repairs.symptoms: A rattle or buzz from the windshield's outer edge molding above about 55 mph. Separately, owners chasing a rattle at the lower driver's-side corner of the windshield found leaves trapped near the hood hinge and in the wiper well.
repairs.fix: Lexus bulletin L-SB-0019-24 (April 2024) covers a rattle or buzz from the windshield outer edge molding above 55 mph on 2022–2024 LX 600s, so have a dealer inspect and repair the molding under it. Before you book, open the hood and vacuum leaves and debris out of the cowl and wiper well. One owner plans to add foam to keep the leaves out.
repairs.tools: Shop vacuum · flashlight · trim tools if you inspect the molding yourself

repairs.title: Power back door won't close (pinch sensor)
repairs.time: ≈ 5 minutes for the checks. Dealer visit for sensors.
repairs.symptoms: The hatch opens normally, but when you press close it beeps once or twice and won't move, so you have to shut it by hand. The hands-free kick sensor may only beep.
repairs.fix: Rule out the easy causes first. A weak key signal, such as from the credit-card key, can stop it, and a hatch left open for hours can forget its position until you close it by hand once. If it keeps happening, have the pinch (touch) sensors along the hatch edges tested. Two IH8MUD owners, with a 2023 and a 2024 LX 600, had pinch sensors replaced under warranty, one on the left side and the other on both sides. For a kick sensor that only beeps, one owner reset it this way: turn hands-free off in the center console, switch the truck off, open and close the hatch from outside, switch it back on and re-enable hands-free. A bike rack over the bumper sensors can also stop it working.
repairs.tools: Key fob · Lexus dealer for sensor diagnosis

parts.name: Back door touch (pinch) sensor search, LX 600

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: The factory size on 22s is 265/50R22, about 32 in. Owners on aftermarket 20s run 275/60R20 (about 33 in) and 285/55R20 without rubbing, and 275/70R18 fits on Toyota TRD 18-inch wheels. 285/50R22 on factory wheels needed cutting and spacers. Without a lift, plan on about 33 in.

faq.q: Is my LX 600 part of the engine recall?
faq.a: If it's a 2022–2024, possibly. Recall 24V-381 covered 3,524 LX 600s built from July 30, 2021 to November 25, 2022, with engine replacement as the remedy. Recall 25V-767 (Lexus 25LA07) covers 9,895 LXs built from February 26, 2022 to April 2, 2024. Check your VIN at lexus.com/recall or nhtsa.gov. The 25V-767 remedy is a No. 1 main-bearing inspection, with engine replacement if needed.
8,000 lb with trailer brakes, per the owner's manual (1,650 lb without). KBB lists the same 8,000-lb rating for every 2027 LX.

faq.q: Is the LX 600 just a 300 Series Land Cruiser?
faq.a: Underneath, yes: same GA-F platform and 112-in wheelbase. Toyota didn't sell the LC300 in North America, which made the LX 600 the US version.

There's a lockable center diff, but no US LX 600 has front or rear lockers. The F Sport gets a Torsen limited-slip rear. Triple locks came on Japan's LX Offroad grade and, in the US, on the LX 700h Overtrail.

faq.q: How do I use 4L and the diff locks?
faq.a: Owners say the center diff lock can be engaged while moving slowly in Drive. Shifting into 4L requires the truck to be stopped and in neutral. On trucks with axle lockers, the front and rear lockers need 4L and the center lock engaged first, at very low speed. If you switch off the engine in 4L, MTS won't come back on automatically.

faq.q: What fuel economy should I expect?
faq.a: The EPA rates the 2025 LX 600 at 17 mpg city, 22 highway and 19 combined, on premium fuel.

faq.q: How much lighter is it than the LX 570?
faq.a: Lexus says 441 lb (200 kg) lighter, with a frame it calls 20 percent more rigid.
At normal ride height, 25° approach, 23° breakover and 20° departure. Lexus hasn't published figures for the Hi1 and Hi2 heights. Maximum wading depth is 700 mm (27.5 in).

faq.q: Why does it clunk into first gear?
faq.a: Owners report a clunk into first on rolling stops, and sometimes on 6–5 downshifts, in 2022–2024 LX 600s. There's no known fix. Gentle throttle while the transmission decides helps, and larger tires make it less noticeable. Owners say the LX 700h hybrid doesn't do it.

faq.q: Should I buy one without AHC?
faq.a: If you plan to lift it, maybe. Slee Off-Road's LX 600 build was a Premium custom-ordered without AHC so it could run Dobinsons suspension. AHC trucks keep the adjustable ride heights but limit your lift choices.

mods.why: Upper and lower arms correct geometry after a lift and give bigger tires room.
The LX 600 has a big, expensive nose and soft underbody protection. Frame-mounted sliders and a full skid set are the first armor to fit.
A flat platform for a tent, recovery boards and lights.
Swapping the 22s for 18s or 20s is the biggest single capability upgrade you can make.
A dual swing-out rear bumper carries a full-size spare and gear and adds proper rear recovery points. Dissent says it sells its LX600 and LX700h parts only for installation at its shop.

baseline_service.intro: The LX 600 is still young enough that a baseline is mostly about proving what's been done. Check the engine recall status first, then do the early gear-oil change owners recommend, and service the AHC on trucks that have it. Specs come from the LX 600 owner's manual (OM60V34U), and intervals from the 2023 Lexus maintenance schedule.

items.note: Lexus says to replace the element and the filter-cap O-ring together at every oil change.

items.interval: Every 30,000 mi. Inspect more often off-road.

items.note: The interval is much shorter than on the old V8s, so check the records.
